---
title: "Zum Home-Bildschirm hinzufügen"
---

Die Webseite kann wie eine App auf dem Home-Bildschirm gespeichert werden.

<div class="tutorial-platform-switch" role="group" aria-label="Betriebssystem auswählen">
  <button type="button" class="tutorial-platform-button active" data-platform="ios">
    iPhone / iPad
  </button>

  <button type="button" class="tutorial-platform-button" data-platform="android">
    Android
  </button>
</div>

<p class="tutorial-hint">
  ← Wischen, um die einzelnen Schritte anzuzeigen →
</p>


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)

steps <- read_excel(
  "data/content.xlsx",
  sheet = "tutorial_steps"
) |>
  arrange(platform, seq)


render_tutorial <- function(platform_name) {

  x <- steps |>
    filter(
      tolower(platform) ==
        tolower(platform_name)
    )

  cards <- vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(x)),
    function(i) {

      image <- as.character(x$image[i])
      caption <- as.character(x$caption[i])
      seq <- x$seq[i]

      paste0(
        "<article class='tutorial-step'>",

          "<div class='tutorial-step-number'>",
            seq,
          "</div>",

          "<div class='tutorial-image-wrap'>",
            "<img ",
              "src='", htmlEscape(image), "' ",
              "alt='Schritt ", seq, "' ",
              "loading='lazy' ",
              "decoding='async'>",
          "</div>",

          "<p class='tutorial-caption'>",
            htmlEscape(caption),
          "</p>",

        "</article>"
      )
    },
    character(1)
  )

  cat(
    paste0(
      "<div ",
        "class='tutorial-platform' ",
        "data-tutorial-platform='",
        platform_name,
        "'>",
        "<div class='tutorial-roll'>",
          paste0(cards, collapse = ""),
        "</div>",
      "</div>"
    )
  )
}


render_tutorial("ios")
render_tutorial("android")
```


```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const buttons =
    document.querySelectorAll(
      ".tutorial-platform-button"
    );

  const tutorials =
    document.querySelectorAll(
      ".tutorial-platform"
    );

  function showPlatform(platform) {

    buttons.forEach(button => {
      button.classList.toggle(
        "active",
        button.dataset.platform === platform
      );
    });

    tutorials.forEach(tutorial => {
      tutorial.hidden =
        tutorial.dataset.tutorialPlatform !== platform;
    });
  }

  buttons.forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener(
      "click",
      function () {
        showPlatform(
          this.dataset.platform
        );
      }
    );
  });

  showPlatform("ios");
});
</script>
```


```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener(
  "DOMContentLoaded",
  function () {

    const params =
      new URLSearchParams(
        window.location.search
      );

    if (
      params.get("embed") === "1"
    ) {
      document.body.classList.add(
        "tutorial-embedded"
      );
    }
  }
);
</script>
```
